gloss: to ruin the atmosphere; to kill the mood

definitions.gloss: to ruin the atmosphere; to kill the mood; to destroy the vibe
definitions.explanation: To say or do something that disrupts the harmonious or positive atmosphere of a social situation. Related to the cultural concept of 'reading the air' (空気を読む).

examples.japanese: {空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}すようなことを{言|い}ってしまった。
examples.english: I ended up saying something that ruined the mood.

examples.japanese: せっかくの{楽|たの}しい{雰囲気|ふんいき}を{壊|こわ}さないでほしい。
examples.english: Please don't ruin the fun atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はいつも{場|ば}の{空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}すような{発言|はつげん}をする。
examples.english: He always makes remarks that kill the mood.

notes:
USAGE:
{空気|くうき} (air/atmosphere) in Japanese social contexts refers to the unspoken mood, tone, or consensus of a group. {空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}す means to disrupt this shared atmosphere, often by saying something inappropriate, insensitive, or off-topic.

Related to the well-known expression {空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む (to read the atmosphere), which describes the valued ability to sense the mood and act accordingly. A person who cannot do this is called KY ({空気|くうき}{読|よ}めない).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {場|ば}の{空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}す (to ruin the atmosphere of the place)
- {空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}す{発言|はつげん} (a mood-killing remark)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む: to read the room — the ability to sense the mood
- {場|ば}を{白|しら}けさせる: to dampen the mood — similar meaning, emphasizes awkward silence
